text_block_list.text:
At long last, Симболи Рудольф's racing
debut is
upon us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite the early hour, the venue is
electric. The
atmosphere feels more like
a graded race than a
simple debut.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hah! The race hasn't even begun, and I
can feel
the crowd's excitement from
here.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: You're the one they're waiting for.

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. All eyes are on me, perhaps
more now
than there ever will be.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Only today are they free to wonder how
I
measure up to the title of Emperor.
Once I take
to the track, I'll become a
known quantity.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That means my performance today is
crucial.
Anything less than the best will
disappoint them.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: That sounds like a lot of pressure.

text_block_list.text:
Surely you know better than that. Who
do you
take me for?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: If anything, I see this as an opportunity.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If the crowd is this excited before
they've even
seen me run, imagine the
fame we'll enjoy if I
account for myself
well.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
So, worry not. Or rather, I should say... I
will not
let you down.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Today we take the first step on our road
of
conquest.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
